data.one_liner: An image cropper package made in Flutter to crop and rotate images.
data.what_it_does: CropperX provides a Flutter widget that allows users to crop and rotate images directly inside the app. It supports multiple overlay types including circles, rectangles, and grids. The cropped image can be retrieved as bytes using a global key reference.
use_when: You need an in-app UI for users to crop and rotate images
You want support for custom overlay guides like circles or grid lines
avoid_when: You need a full-featured image picker instead of a cropping widget
You need non-widget-based server-side or background image processing without UI
strengths: Supports multiple overlay shapes and grid types
Supports image rotation with custom turns
weaknesses: Limited to what is provided by the custom widget and GlobalKey mechanism
Not documented for advanced image manipulation beyond cropping and rotating
